reason: Mixing the dispersed outer gas with a cold stream directly addresses whether cold material can survive in the outskirts.
expectation: The gases will interact; I expect at least some cold material may persist, though the mixing could heat it.

alternatives.reason: The dusty cloud could also meet the cold stream, but I want to follow the previously dispersed gas first.

effect: The cold stream formed a sheltered pocket and completed the survival goal; I now need to pursue what the cluster can illuminate.
reaction: The contrast between the cold pocket and the much larger hot surroundings was interesting.
reason: Adding surviving grains to the cold cloud may prepare material for the cluster to illuminate.
expectation: The grains will mix into the cold cloud, possibly making a dusty cloud the cluster can illuminate.

alternatives.reason: The cluster's dusty material could also interact with the outskirts, but I want to follow the newly formed cold cloud.

effect: The grains made a dusty cloud beside the cluster, ready to be illuminated by its existing stars.
reaction: The distinction between visible dust and newly formed stars is interesting.
reason: Combining the cloud with the surviving cluster directly addresses the remaining goal.
expectation: The cluster's starlight will illuminate the dusty cloud, without forming new stars.

effect: The cluster illuminated the dusty cloud without forming new stars, completing the remaining goal.
reaction: That distinction made the final result satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Illuminating the dusty cloud connected the surviving cluster to the cold material and showed how dust can be visible without new stars.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding grains to the cold cloud felt somewhat like a preparation for the more interesting illumination result.

surprise.text: I was interested that a sheltered cold pocket could survive mixing while the larger surroundings remained hot and thin.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, although the fast menu supplied compatible combinations rather than letting me discover them.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow how the surviving cluster and its surroundings evolve, though this chapter's choices were fairly straightforward.
